result.description: Northfall Auric Lantern is a fictional ceramic aroma diffuser with a 250 ml water reservoir, ultrasonic mist output, and warm amber LED lighting. It supports timer modes of 1, 3, and 6 hours, includes an auto-shutoff safety feature, and is designed for quiet tabletop use in bedrooms or offices.
